cost: B=|size|, C=|cap|: initialization O(B log(B+1)+C), including n=0; rounds O(R B log(B+C+1)), R<=B+1. Selection adds O(P log(P+B+1)) comparisons and row/text scans. String comparison, cloning and hashing bytes are additional; no measured speed claim.
description: Exact capped Hamilton quotas compose with deterministic paragraph pools and pure ordered-row normalization.
forward: Normalize rows; allocate exact capped quotas; balance pools; rank per-document; sort indices.
inverse: Set-valued antecedents lose ignored row ord, rejected paragraphs and metadata; positive common weight scaling preserves quotas.
limitations: Finite oracle evidence, not semantic proof.
state: Supplied Para/Pick, skip keys, size/cap maps and SQL-shaped synthetic rows.
